purpose: Check paired samplers, forward/backward, stratified validation and checkpoint I/O. Not a performance experiment, deployment or formal GPU training protocol.

sampling.baseline: Uniform weights for every training window. Same sampling mechanism as balanced arm; not historical shuffle-without-replacement replay.
sampling.balanced: Keep fault and RflySim weights=1; give each of original-normal and pre-fault-normal SIL/HIL pools half their combined total probability mass.
sampling.invariants: Total weight, binary class probabilities and RflySim probability unchanged; only split within SIL/HIL normal pools changes. Finite random draws fluctuate, so per-batch counts need not match.

training.initialization: One shared random state, identically loaded into both arms; no historical pretrained weights loaded.
training.scheduler: constant learning rate for this smoke check only

validation.subset: Four existing cache windows per source validation case, evenly spaced within its ordered cap64 windows; 555 cases / 2220 windows.
validation.checkpoint: Best overall sampled-validation Macro-F1, plus last state and per-epoch history; reload best and verify evaluation matches saved epoch.
validation.interpretation: Tiny sampled validation and only eight training updates per arm: verify plumbing only, never infer effectiveness from scores.

forbidden: claiming GPU readiness or model improvement from this check
future: Formal paired training recipe, epochs, validation selection rule and GPU launcher still require separate registration and integration.
